title: What changed in prediction markets
insights:
- **Kalshi’s dollar flow fell faster than contract volume:** On Nov. 20, it traded 3.77B contracts, 4.9% below its seven-day average; taker-side dollar volume was $732.9M, 13.7% below its prior-30-day daily average of $849.6M.
- **DKeX trading dropped below its recent pace:** On Nov. 17, it traded 120M contracts, 39.2% below its seven-day average of 197.5M and 39.1% below its prior-30-day daily average of 197.1M.
- **Polymarket US was also below its weekly average:** Its Nov. 17 volume was 463.1M contracts, 11.9% under the seven-day average of 525.5M.

evidence.label: Additional context 1
evidence.sql:
WITH anchor AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS report_date
    FROM taker_notional_daily
    WHERE date <= DATE '2026-11-20'
),
current_day AS (
    SELECT t.date, t.notional_total
    FROM taker_notional_daily t
    JOIN anchor a ON t.date = a.report_date
),
baseline AS (
    SELECT AVG(t.notional_total) AS avg_notional_total
    FROM taker_notional_daily t
    CROSS JOIN anchor a
    WHERE t.date >= a.report_date - INTERVAL 30 DAY
      AND t.date < a.report_date
),
volume AS (
    SELECT d.contracts_total
    FROM daily_overall d
    JOIN anchor a ON d.date = a.report_date
)
SELECT
    c.date,
    c.notional_total AS taker_side_dollar_volume,
    b.avg_notional_total AS prior_30_day_daily_average_taker_side_dollar_volume,
    (c.notional_total / NULLIF(b.avg_notional_total, 0) - 1) * 100 AS pct_change_vs_prior_30_day_average,
    v.contracts_total AS contracts_traded
FROM current_day c
CROSS JOIN baseline b
CROSS JOIN volume v;

evidence.label: Additional context 2
evidence.sql:
WITH anchor AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS report_date
    FROM competitor_daily
    WHERE platform = 'DKeX'
      AND COALESCE(complete, TRUE)
      AND date <= DATE '2026-11-20'
),
current_day AS (
    SELECT c.date, c.contracts
    FROM competitor_daily c
    JOIN anchor a ON c.date = a.report_date
    WHERE c.platform = 'DKeX'
      AND COALESCE(c.complete, TRUE)
),
baseline AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(c.contracts) AS avg_contracts,
        MEDIAN(c.contracts) AS median_contracts,
        MIN(c.contracts) AS min_contracts,
        MAX(c.contracts) AS max_contracts,
        COUNT(*) AS reporting_days
    FROM competitor_daily c
    CROSS JOIN anchor a
    WHERE c.platform = 'DKeX'
      AND COALESCE(c.complete, TRUE)
      AND c.date >= a.report_date - INTERVAL 30 DAY
      AND c.date < a.report_date
)
SELECT
    c.date,
    c.contracts AS reported_contracts,
    b.avg_contracts AS prior_30_day_daily_average,
    b.median_contracts AS prior_30_day_daily_median,
    b.min_contracts AS prior_30_day_minimum,
    b.max_contracts AS prior_30_day_maximum,
    b.reporting_days,
    (c.contracts / NULLIF(b.avg_contracts, 0) - 1) * 100 AS pct_change_vs_prior_30_day_average
FROM current_day c
CROSS JOIN baseline b;

anchor.question: Build the anchor table for today's Predict Charts industry briefing. For each prediction-market venue, use its latest complete reported day and return venue, report date, reported contract volume, the average of its prior seven complete reported days, and percent change versus that average. Use daily_overall for Kalshi and exclude rows where is_partial is true. Use competitor_daily only for platforms other than Kalshi, add ProphetX from prophetx_daily, and add CME from cme_daily. Never use competitor_daily's Kalshi row; it is not the authoritative Kalshi total. In competitor_daily the `complete` column is only populated for Polymarket_US and is NULL for every other platform, where NULL means the row IS complete. Filter it as COALESCE(complete, TRUE) or omit the filter entirely; never write `complete = TRUE`, which silently discards every platform whose flag is NULL. Exclude partial days. CME is the sparse bulletin series; a normal seven-day lookback spanning seven calendar days is regular, not sparse. Resolve the latest complete reported day SEPARATELY FOR EACH VENUE. Do not filter the whole result to one shared calendar date, and do not require a venue to have a row on the newest date any venue reported: a venue whose most recent complete day is a few days old is reporting normally and still belongs in the table, on its own date. Each venue's prior-seven-day baseline is its own prior seven REPORTED days, which for an irregular reporter spans more than seven calendar days. Every one of these ten venues must appear in the result: Kalshi, Polymarket US, ForecastEx, DKeX, Underdog Exchange, OG/Crypto.com, ProphetX, Novig, Rothera, CME. OG/Crypto.com is the platform stored as 'Crypto.com/Nadex'.
anchor.sql:
WITH venue_days AS (
    SELECT
        'Kalshi' AS venue,
        date AS report_date,
        contracts_total AS contracts
    FROM daily_overall
    WHERE COALESCE(is_partial, FALSE) = FALSE

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        CASE platform
            WHEN 'Polymarket_US' THEN 'Polymarket US'
            WHEN 'Crypto.com/Nadex' THEN 'OG/Crypto.com'
            ELSE platform
        END AS venue,
        date AS report_date,
        contracts
    FROM competitor_daily
    WHERE platform IN (
        'Polymarket_US',
        'ForecastEx',
        'DKeX',
        'Underdog Exchange',
        'Crypto.com/Nadex',
        'Novig',
        'Rothera'
    )
      AND COALESCE(complete, TRUE)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'ProphetX' AS venue,
        date AS report_date,
        contracts
    FROM prophetx_daily
    WHERE COALESCE(complete, TRUE)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'CME' AS venue,
        date AS report_date,
        cme_total_vol AS contracts
    FROM cme_daily
),
ranked_days AS (
    SELECT
        venue,
        report_date,
        contracts,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY venue
            ORDER BY report_date DESC
        ) AS day_rank
    FROM venue_days
)
SELECT
    venue,
    MAX(report_date) FILTER (WHERE day_rank = 1) AS report_date,
    MAX(contracts) FILTER (WHERE day_rank = 1) AS reported_contract_volume,
    AVG(contracts) FILTER (WHERE day_rank BETWEEN 2 AND 8) AS prior_seven_reported_day_avg,
    (
        MAX(contracts) FILTER (WHERE day_rank = 1)
        / NULLIF(AVG(contracts) FILTER (WHERE day_rank BETWEEN 2 AND 8), 0)
        - 1
    ) * 100 AS pct_change_vs_prior_seven_avg
FROM ranked_days
WHERE day_rank <= 8
GROUP BY venue
ORDER BY venue;
